set.body:
Source audit requested by compact covariance issue bd-01M1WN5BAJ3WXZZ1H80EEE6TR0 found a separate optional-status path. RunwiseFmriRunResult.resolvedVoxelStatuses uses voxelStatuses.getOrElse(Vector.fill(coefficients.voxels)(Estimable)); FixedEffects.selectVoxels invokes fixedEffectsStatus for every voxel/run, and that helper reads resolvedVoxelStatuses(voxelPosition). With None, this allocates a full V-element default vector R*V times: source-level O(R*V^2) reference work. DenseFmriFitResult.voxelStatus also materializes the vector for a point lookup. The full-vector accessor itself may remain an intentional materialization API; point consumers should not invoke it unnecessarily.

Owner: ScalaFIM fit shared module. Preserve the exact default-Estimable behavior, residual-variance refinement, explicit status handling, source voxel identity, and invalid/out-of-range behavior. Use a direct checked status lookup or resolve once per run without weakening validation. Add bounded public API reproduction and equivalence/resource evidence on JVM and JS. Do not use a wall-clock threshold as the only regression proof.

This is currently a source-backed performance finding; a dedicated runtime reproduction and repair remain open. It did not cause the real ds000001 covariance resource issue: those chunked fits retain explicit statuses. Real compact covariance/coverage evidence is in PLS Neuro commit0a14cfb908f6b38967b3776603ed8a325c87b6bf, docs/verification/real-cohort-coverage.json. Keep this distinct from the completed structured covariance representation and the application post-fit coverage review.
set.title: Avoid full fallback status-vector allocation for single-voxel access
